Strategy: Strengthen the best pure bonus band reward to twenty-five, testing whether a bigger bonus for leftovers between twenty-eight and forty-two helps more. It may help by committing harder to the good window, but may fail if the stronger bonus overrides tight fits too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) for r in bins]
```
